newsitem.title: USA: Imation to end sales of Onyx plates in '97.
newsitem.headline: Imation to end sales of Onyx plates in '97.

text.p: Imation Corp said Wednesday it plans to stop selling its Onyx brand polyester plates, effective June 30, 1997.
The move should not have a material impact on its total revenue in 1997 or beyond, the company said.

"Imation's strategy is to expand our leadership position in digital and conventional proofing and to strengthen our ability to deliver digital workflow solutions that are of greater value to our customers and Imation," the company said in a release.
Imation said it would produce Onyx plates at its Rochester, N.Y., facility through mid-December and supply customers through June 30, 1997.
The company said it will no longer sell the 3M 1190 Onyx Platemaker, effective immediately, but will continue to provide parts and service for equipment under existing customer agreements.
